description: Compare Social Security claiming ages 62-70 for a single client or a couple (all 81 combinations), including spousal top-ups, survivor benefits and delayed credits, ranked by present value in today's dollars. Returns the best available strategy, the top ten, claiming at 62, 67 and 70 for comparison, breakeven ages for the primary and the assumptions. PIA is the monthly benefit at full retirement age from the client's SSA statement.

discountRate.description: Real discount rate in percent for present values (default 2).

lifeExpectancy.description: Age at death assumed for the analysis (default 90).

pia.description: Primary insurance amount: monthly benefit at full retirement age, in dollars.

spouse.description: The spouse, for a married couple.
